definition.en: The part of air’s force that acts at right angles to the incoming airflow. When an aircraft banks, lift tilts with it.
definition.zh: 空气作用力中垂直于来流的部分。飞机倾斜时，升力也跟着倾斜。

definition.en: The force pulling an aircraft towards Earth. The aircraft, fuel, passengers and cargo all contribute to its weight.
definition.zh: 把飞机拉向地球的力。飞机、燃油、乘客和货物都计入重量。

definition.en: The force from an aircraft’s propulsion system that pushes it forwards through the air.
definition.zh: 飞机的推进系统提供的力，推动飞机在空气中向前。

definition.en: The part of air’s force that acts along the incoming airflow and opposes the aircraft’s movement through the air.
definition.zh: 空气作用力中沿来流方向的部分，阻碍飞机在空气中运动。

definition.en: The shape seen when a wing is sliced from front to back. This is a cross-section, rather than the whole wing’s outline from above.
definition.zh: 把机翼从前缘到后缘切开，看到的剖面形状。整块机翼从上方看的轮廓是另一种形状。

definition.en: The straight line joining an airfoil’s front edge, or leading edge, to its back edge, or trailing edge.
definition.zh: 连接翼型前缘和后缘的直线。

definition.en: The angle between the chord and the incoming air. The aircraft’s nose angle above the horizon is a different measurement.
definition.zh: 翼弦与来流之间的角。机头与地平线之间的角是另一种量。

definition.en: When air breaks away from the wing at a large angle of attack and lift falls. The engine can keep running during a wing stall.
definition.zh: 迎角较大时，空气离开翼面，升力下降。机翼失速时，发动机仍可运转。

definition.en: Force on each unit of area. Adding the pressure forces across the wing’s surface gives the aerodynamic force.
definition.zh: 每单位面积上受到的力。把翼面各处的气压作用合起来，就得到空气动力。

definition.en: A line following the air’s direction at every point. In this steady-flow model, the pattern stays fixed; line spacing does not directly show speed.
definition.zh: 沿各处气流方向画出的线。这个模型的气流形状保持稳定，线的疏密不直接表示速度。

definition.en: Hinged surfaces that change the aircraft’s rotation. Ailerons change roll, elevators change pitch and the rudder changes yaw.
definition.zh: 可以偏转、改变飞机转动的翼面。副翼改变滚转，升降舵改变俯仰，方向舵改变偏航。

definition.en: Movable parts that change a wing for slower flight. Flaps sit on the back edge and slats on the front edge. Extended flaps also add drag.
definition.zh: 改变机翼形状、帮助慢速飞行的活动部件。襟翼位于后缘，缝翼位于前缘。襟翼伸出也增加阻力。

definition.en: Spars run along a wing’s span and carry bending loads. Ribs run from front to back and hold the airfoil shape.
definition.zh: 翼梁沿翼展延伸，承受使机翼弯曲的力。翼肋从前缘伸向后缘，保持翼型。

definition.en: A turbine engine with a large front fan. Air flows through a central core and around it through a bypass duct. The bypass ratio compares the air mass passing around and through the core each second.
definition.zh: 前方有大风扇的涡轮发动机。空气一路穿过中央核心，一路沿外涵道绕过核心。涵道比比较每秒绕过与穿过核心的空气质量。

definition.en: The compressor, combustor and turbines inside a turbofan’s core. The compressor squeezes air, fuel burns in the combustor and hot gas turns turbines to drive the shafts.
definition.zh: 涡扇核心里的压气机、燃烧室和涡轮。压气机压缩空气，燃料在燃烧室燃烧，热气带动涡轮和轴转动。

definition.en: The mass of air in a given volume. In the average-atmosphere model, air density falls as height increases.
definition.zh: 一定体积内空气的质量。平均大气模型中，高度增加，空气密度减小。
